findings: The canonical V366 Startseite already de-duplicates full world renders with its own v366Sig signature, so HOME-5's additional 120 ms render throttle was unnecessary and could suppress a legitimate fast state change.
The Frost-Todesritter has a real weapon2 slot, but the Startseite checklist counted only the six standard equipment slots.
As a result, the checklist could show all gear enchanted/socketed even when Waffe II was not.
changes: Removed the additional HOME-5 time-based v085InstallWorld suppression.
Kept V366's native signature-based render de-duplication as the sole world render authority.
Added a beta post-render checklist correction for Frost-Todesritter.
Frost enchant/gem checklist now evaluates 7 slots: head, weapon, weapon2, ring, body, boots, amulet.
The visible counters now show x/7 for Frost and only show Komplett when all seven real slots are equipped and upgraded.
